title: Source transport for ordinary finite reduction
statement: For the constant-completion coefficient data, the source finite-reduced functor admits a natural isomorphism to the canonical finite quotient model change(projection J A I n) followed by pullback along constantMap F (A / I^(n+1)).

source.place: Tags 03EK and 03EL; the source-side normalized finite pullback and quotient comparisons

proof.text: Whisker the normalized ordinary finite pullback isomorphism on the left by restriction of scalars, then whisker the normalized finite comparison on the right.
